description: This is a Python source file that implements a WebRTC-based chatbot pipeline using Pipecat framework. It orchestrates components such as speech-to-text, language model interaction, text-to-speech, and transport handling to facilitate an interactive conversational AI.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Contains the context messages for the language model interaction.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with the context for LLM communication.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters configuring user turn strategies within the LLM context.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversation pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline instance with its parameters and configuration.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a pipeline, such as metrics enabling.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, including handling signals and shutdown.

classes.name: CartesiaSTTService
classes.description: Service interface for speech-to-text conversion via Cartesia.

classes.name: CartesiaHttpTTSService
classes.description: Service interface for text-to-speech via Cartesia HTTP API.

classes.name: OpenAILLMService
classes.description: Interface to interact with the OpenAI language models.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Configuration for WebSocket transport using FastAPI.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and runs the speech processing pipeline with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point for starting the bot, creating transport and initiating the pipeline.
